verses.pali: “Pañcahi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato mātugāmo ekantaamanāpo hoti purisassa.
verses.english: “Mendicants, when a lady has five factors she is extremely undesirable to a man.

verses.pali: Na ca rūpavā hoti, na ca bhogavā hoti, na ca sīlavā hoti, alaso ca hoti, pajañcassa na labhati—
verses.english: She’s not attractive, wealthy, or ethical; she’s idle, and she doesn’t beget children.

verses.pali: imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi aṅgehi samannāgato mātugāmo ekantaamanāpo hoti purisassa.
verses.english: When a lady has these five factors she is extremely undesirable to a man.

verses.pali: Pañcahi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato mātugāmo ekantamanāpo hoti purisassa.
verses.english: When a lady has five factors she is extremely desirable to a man.

verses.pali: Rūpavā ca hoti, bhogavā ca hoti, sīlavā ca hoti, dakkho ca hoti analaso, pajañcassa labhati—
verses.english: She’s attractive, wealthy, and ethical; she’s deft and tireless, and she begets children.

verses.pali: imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi aṅgehi samannāgato mātugāmo ekantamanāpo hoti purisassā”ti.
verses.english: When a lady has these five factors she is extremely desirable to a man.”
